Events.js is copied from sources/Game/Events.js.
Inputs/Keyboard.js is copied from sources/Game/Inputs/Keyboard.js with key-repeat deduplication.
FollowView.js adapts the spherical camera, aspect-ratio compensation, tracked focus and zoom smoothing from sources/Game/View.js for this standalone WebGL scene.

The GigaMail world, envelope vehicle, workflow simulation, stations and UI are original adaptations. This is not the complete Bruno Simon portfolio, its Rapier vehicle simulation, or its original map.
